<quote by="Announced by Laughlan Vi Temeschwar, Master of Rings">To construct a Grand Highway, named for the first League orc to die in battle for the Empire, Curstag von Apulian Crimson Way. Which will connect Redoubt, Spiral, and Mareave through Urizen vision and League skill Curstag's Way will support out unshackled cousins and show the septs of Mareave how the Empire builds up its people. In Curstag's final words: "There are so many people on the Broken Shores who deserve saving".</quote>
==Overview==
* Constructs a [[great work]] in [[Spiral]] as per the '''[[We_all_stand#Trade_Routes|We all stand]]''' wind of fortune
* Announcement by the [[Master of Rings]]
* As this was announced by the Master of Rings it will receive support from some of the citizens of Apulian
==Date==
* Autumn 386YE
==Cost==
* Costs as per opportunity
* 50 white granite
* 20 mithril
* 210 crowns
* Six months to complete
==Progress==
{{CommissionProgress|Curstag%27s_Way}}
==Outcome==
* Now complete, Curstag's Way has raised the level of investment in Spiral businesses by one, providing 36 rings a season. It has also removed the under-developed quality from Icarion in [[Mareave]]
